attempted_claim: Let f:(X,D) → T be a flat family of log-smooth couples over a smooth (not necessarily proper) base T of relative dimension d, with X smooth and D a smooth Weil divisor. Assume (X_t, cD_t) is a K-semistable log Fano pair for every t in T and every c in (0,1). Put P=[0,1], let eG in G(d,1,P) be the set of fibres (X_t,D_t), and let bG be its moduli completion in the sense of Liu-Zhou Definition 1.2 (add all K-semistable log Fano degenerations (Y,cB), c in P, of pairs arising from eG). Let v_0 = vol(-K_{X_t} - D_t), independent of t. If v_0 = 0, is bG still log bounded?
decisive_failure: The investigation was bounded by a single consolidated literature call plus fulltext study of Liu-Zhou, bounded volume computations in output/artifacts/volumes_test.py, and elementary intersection checks on candidate counterexamples. It does not rule out a future resolution using volume-independent boundedness tools beyond Liu-Zhou, nor a subtler unbounded degeneration sequence satisfying log-Fano ampleness near c=1.
